arStrings.szText: {c_important}Reap{/c} sweeps a second time, dealing {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_ECHO}{/c} damage and generating {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} Essence.

{c_important}Reap{/c} becomes a {c_important}Blood{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_BLOOD}{/c} Physical damage.

{c_important}Reap{/c} will {c_important}{u}Execute{/c}{/u} enemies and has a {c_number}[{SF_30} * 100|%|]{/c} chance to form a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/u}{/c} if they are killed by it.

{c_important}Reap{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_COLD}{/c} Cold damage and {c_important}{u}Chills{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[{SF_20}|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Reap{/c} gains an additional {c_number}[{SF_27} * 100|%+|]{/c} Cast Speed.
{c_important}Reap{/c} gains an additional {c_number}[{SF_5}*100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance.
{c_important}Reap{/c} generates {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} additional Essence per enemy hit.
{c_important}Reap{/c} forms a Corpse under the first enemy hit.
